name: Entropia Universe
detailed_description:
Entropia Universe is a unique massively multiplayer online game (MMO) where virtual assets hold real-world value and players can participate in a thriving virtual sandbox economy. The platform has been live since 2003 and continues to push the boundaries of virtual economy design.

Set in a persistent, single-shard universe, Entropia Universe offers a deep and evolving sci-fi world spanning multiple planets and vast space environments. Unlike traditional class-based MMOs, players progress through infinite skill development, with the freedom to define their own roles and paths.

Players can invest in in-game companies, own land areas, and even acquire shares that pay real dividends, connecting gameplay with genuine economic opportunity.

Many Ways to Play

Given its "no-class" system, and real cash economy, Entropia Universe has many professions that players can specialize and participate in such as:

  • Hunting - Hunt creatures, fight bosses, complete dungeons

  • Mining - survey the land and extract resources used in crafting

  • Crafting - Craft items in demand

  • Trading - Buy low, sell high. Become a skilled entrepreneur 

  • Taming Creatures - Tame sought-after creatures around the universe and sell them for profit

  • Beauty Services - Skill up and offer avatar modification services

  • Shop Owning - Buy and run your very own shop in a persistent world

  • Land Area Owning - Own a huge slice of virtual land to generate revenue from taxes

  • Investing - Buy and sell shares on the Entropia Exchange

  • PvP - Take on other players in lootable PvP
